It had low health and an above average speed. ==Appearance== '''Dust''' had a slate textured dark purple body, with a transparent neon lavender outline on its whole body. ==Strategy== *Towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Ace Pilot]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Mortar]] are great choices to deal with these. **You can also use the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] to boost these towers' firerate and range respectively. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Night Four - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Dust''' on a promotional video. }} ==Update History== *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **'''Dust''' added. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Dust''' removed. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Solar Eclipse]] [[Category:Totality Tower]] [[Category:Tower Outskirts]]
